scientific_integrity: The analytic proof supplies an exact conditional urn law, a uniform late-birth bound and separate treatment of histories containing an early mutation. The primary literature establishes the model and qualitative leadership limits; the derivative constants are derived here. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: One-sided p approaching 1 after the graph-size limit, not a simultaneous n,p limit.
No second-order expansion or exact formula away from the endpoint.
The 2026 motivating preprint full text was inaccessible for exhaustive priority comparison.
Finite checker is diagnostic and not an independent infinity-proof.
title: Distinct endpoint slopes for eventual and eternal leadership in recursive-tree percolation
